bounded_funding_witness.conclusion: No material owner seed parent was established from this bounded sample. The zero screen receipt count is incomplete coverage, not evidence that no funder exists.
bounded_funding_witness.selected_owner_history_scope: Bounded recent-address probes only; no exhaustive funding ancestry.

casebook_comparison.Cfiyy_DgT6: Imported seed families each have four verified relay edges plus four funding edges with exact buy-amount matches; BmFdp is shared funding source. Cfiyy alone has a same-venue AMM drain >=90% after >=20 SOL peak. Target scan has zero verified current relays/funding and cannot be linked by exact wallets.
casebook_comparison.Cvy_7x_Gazk: Prior casebook cohorts show repeated buyers/rapid sells, but no exact target owner overlap; the cited Cvy cohort records no direct token transfer among its four members and no common-control proof.
casebook_comparison.comparison_limit: These are analogies only. Their later outcomes or records are not target entry features.

collector_boundary.coverage_conclusion: Coverage is incomplete and the timing cause of the 77 future-blockTime warnings cannot be reconstructed from saved runtime data. These 77 status rows do not establish relay content because their transaction bodies were not fetched in the scan.
collector_boundary.meaning_of_observed_at_ms: For a normally completed scan, this field is overwritten with local_now_ms at completion (current source line 1198). The initial scan-start value is returned only on invalid-input early return; this persisted field is not a per-request timestamp.
collector_boundary.per_rpc_response_available_at_ms: Not captured for this historical runtime. Current source has been repaired to capture local_now_ms after each getSignaturesForAddress response and pass that per-response availability time to the signature parser. The deployed source hash is not preserved, so the current implementation does not prove which cutoff the historical VM used or what per-response cutoff it saw. The current blockTime being 6.740 seconds before the persisted scan availability timestamp does not adjudicate the per-response comparison.
collector_boundary.source_code: Current source: src/bot/fake_coin_history.rs lines 906-950 (per-response availability passed to parser) and 1198 (normal-completion scan timestamp). Historical deployed source hash was not captured.

ordering_caveat.rule: Provider transaction indices differ; same-slot temporal ordering in this witness uses Shyft getBlock indices only.
